## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A 15-juan early-Qīng continuation of the *Sēngbǎo zhuàn* tradition ([KR6q0040](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0040) + [KR6q0041](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0041)), covering Chán biographies from the Southern Sòng through the Yuán and Míng. Compiled by Zìróng with substantial supplementary material added by Xìnglěi.

**Abstract**

The work completes the three-part *Sēngbǎo zhuàn* sub-tradition by adding the post-Northern-Sòng generations that [慧洪](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%85%A7%E6%B4%AA) Huìhóng's original ([KR6q0040](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0040)) and [祖琇](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%A5%96%E7%90%87) Zǔxiù's first continuation ([KR6q0041](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0041)) had not covered. Editorial method follows the established *Sēngbǎo zhuàn* literary-biographical format. Circulated in the Jiāxīng 嘉興 canon.
